brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold each modifier onto the word it modifies.

t.zh: 这一句里有两个介词短语，一个说明名词，一个说明动作，而且一个套在另一个里面。
t.en: This sentence has two prepositional phrases, one telling about a noun and one about the action, one inside the other.

hint.zh: “用于图像分类”说的是什么样的东西？
hint.en: “For image classification” tells what kind of thing?

hint.zh: 在三个基准上做的是什么？
hint.en: What is done on three benchmarks?

sentence: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.

evaluate.zh: 挂在 evaluate 上，就成了“为了图像分类去评估”。这里 for 说明的是哪一类基准。
evaluate.en: Hung on evaluate, it means evaluating for the sake of image classification. Here for says which kind of benchmarks.

folds.span: on three benchmarks for image classification

method.zh: “在三个基准上的方法”说不通：在基准上进行的是评估。
method.en: “The method on three benchmarks” makes no sense: what happens on the benchmarks is the evaluation.

title.zh: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.
title.en: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.

body.zh: for image classification 挂在 benchmarks 上（图像分类的基准），整块 on three benchmarks … 挂在 evaluate 上（在这些基准上评估）。我们在三个图像分类基准上评估这个方法。
body.en: for image classification hangs on benchmarks (image-classification benchmarks), and the whole on three benchmarks … on evaluate (evaluating on them). We evaluate the method on three image-classification benchmarks.

note.zh: 里面那块挂名词，外面那块挂动词：一层层看意思。
note.en: The inner piece on a noun, the outer on the verb: read the meaning layer by layer.
